column1: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C); grease an 8x12-inch pan and line it with parchment.
Whisk the melted butter, oil and both sugars together in a medium bowl.
Add the eggs and vanilla and beat about 1 minute until lightened in color.
Sift in the flour, cocoa and salt and fold gently just until combined; do not overmix.
Fold in three quarters of the chocolate.
Spread the batter in the pan and scatter the remaining chocolate on top.
Bake 25–30 minutes for fudgy brownies (center just set) or 35–40 minutes for firmer ones.
Cool in the pan 15–20 minutes, lift out and cool fully before cutting into 16 squares.
